verdict.rationale: Signifyd documents a programmatic webhook-registration endpoint ("Create a new webhook") and outbound HTTP webhooks that notify the merchant's store whenever a guarantee decision is made. Its versioning policy also references webhook events and version-targeted webhook tooling, so programmatic consumers can register callbacks and receive events. missing for 10: a documented catalog of all subscribable event types, signature verification and retry/delivery semantics, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Create a new webhook. This will add to the list of any existing webhooks.

Signifyd can send a webhook to notify your online store every time a guarantee decision is made on a submitted order. This provides you with real-time updates enabling you to ship orders quickly and efficiently.
webhook tooling addresses "a specific API version - V2, V3 or ALL"
